_note: From a NotebookLM sweep (2026-10-21). Only fields the sweep filled are kept; every other plan field came back null (Chapter 12 gives weekly km only). Elite UTMB example figures come from podcasts/case studies, not the book: treat as unverified until a human coach confirms.

no_mountain_substitutes.stairs: 10-12 s sprints on steep stairs, 2-3 min rest; or weighted hiking laps >=5 min with 10-15% body weight
no_mountain_substitutes.incline_treadmill: 10 x 4 min at 20-25% incline with 1-2 min rest; or steady weighted hiking at 15-25%
no_mountain_substitutes.weighted_step_ups: box at 75% knee height; 3x20 per leg bodyweight, or 3x8-10 loaded (up to 25% BW); gym ME circuit 6x10, 1x/week for 8-14 weeks
no_mountain_substitutes.sled_or_tire_drag: flat-ground harness drag for horizontal leg drive without impact
